name: Diffusion Posterior Sampling (DPS)
summary: Use a pretrained diffusion score model with measurement guidance for approximate noisy inverse reconstruction.
summary_zh: 把观测似然梯度引入扩散去噪过程，生成近似符合含噪观测的逆问题样本。
core_idea: Insert an approximate likelihood/measurement gradient into diffusion-based reverse sampling.
innovation: Makes nonlinear noisy inverse reconstruction possible with learned image priors and an explicit observation model.
limitations: The produced distribution is an approximate posterior, not generally exact.
Forward operator mismatch and costly sampling can distort uncertainty.

start_here.why: Canonical peer-reviewed diffusion-guided noisy inverse sampler.
start_here.focus: Likelihood guidance, posterior approximation and nonlinear measurement experiments.

curation_note: Bibliographic identity verified against authoritative proceedings; downstream physical inverse validity must be separately evaluated.
